邬旦城。姜家后山。一位身穿染血白袍，面色煞白的俊朗男子，坐在蒲团上。这是哪里？他望着眼前的陌生景象，陷入迷茫。还不等搞清楚状况，海量记忆忽然涌入脑海。我竟然穿越了？姜道玄用手揉着有些发胀的脑袋。自己只是眼睛一闭一睁的功夫，就穿越为邬旦城四大家族之一“姜家”的族长。根据记忆，前身停留先天境圆满许久，为了突破境界，这才毅然来到后山禁地，开始了闭关。只是在闭关第一天，就因为突破丹药被人事先动了手脚，导致突破失败，不幸命殒。而这些都还是其次。最重要的是，因为突破失败，他如今已是境界全失，成为了一个手无缚鸡之力的废人！这可有些不妙了啊……姜道玄神色凝重。此方天地，可是一个集万千伟力归于一身的超凡世界！这里是强者的天堂，至强者可移山填海，摘星拿月，主宰一切！却是弱者的地狱，弱者如草芥，稍有不慎，便会被强者造成的战斗余波震死！在这么一个疯狂的世界里，按照他现在修为全无的状况。自己的人身安全根本得不到保障啊！而这还不是最糟糕的。记忆中，另外三大家族早已虎视眈眈地盯上姜家。也不知道自己闭关了多久？如今的姜家又是何种情况？姜道玄双眉紧锁，眼中充满忧虑。就在这时，一道冰冷的声音忽然在脑海中响起。姜道玄先是一愣，旋即大喜。这可真是山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村啊！没有丝毫犹豫，立即融合先天圣体道胎。下一刻。姜道玄的皮肤表面开始浮现出一层淡金色光晕。强大的近道体质与大道产生共鸣。成千上万缕道韵自虚空垂落，环绕周身，助他进入感悟状态！天地间，隐约传出一阵阵道音，五彩祥瑞浮现而出，大地金莲应运而生！海量的大道之力冲刷着身躯，令如同朽木的身躯，再次焕发出磅礴生机！皮肤好似神玉一般璀璨，周身更是流露出一缕缕如同神药的香气，弥漫空气中。半响后。当姜道玄缓缓睁开眼眸。身躯内已然充斥澎湃至极的生机活力。他抬起手掌，发现已经变得晶莹如玉，通洁无瑕。在成功融合先天圣体道胎，完成肉身重塑之后。这具肉身变得更加契合自己灵魂，实现魂肉合一。虽然相貌没有发生丝毫变化，但内部早已迎来巨大的蜕变！从某种意义上来说，这具肉身完全归属自己，相当于肉身穿越，而非灵魂穿越。不过这样也好。毕竟使用别人的肉身，难免有些膈应。但幸好，在完成肉身重塑之后，这一切问题都不复存在了。姜道玄摇了摇头。随后提起精神，将周身道韵异象散去，使用“全族总和”。霎时间，四周灵力暴动起来，争前恐后，钻入自己体内。海量灵气流淌四肢百骸，疯狂冲刷全身的筋骨皮肉。境界疯狂攀升，直到丹田内汇聚的先天真元开始以量变引起质变！一缕缕真元压缩，蜕变成元力！轰的一声炸响，大量元力凝聚，于顷刻间，在丹田之中开辟出一方虚空！虚空中紫气萦绕，蕴养神魂，显现神识！先天境圆满！紫府境一重！紫府境二重！紫府境三重！姜道玄猛地睁开双眼，眸光如电，摄人心魄！呼。一口浊气吐出，如同箭矢，瞬间洞穿地面，留下一个小坑！这便是紫府境的光景吗？若是放在前世，恐怕就跟个小超人一般了吧？姜道玄心中颇为感慨。在此方世界，境界划分为炼体，凝血，锻骨，后天，先天，紫府，元海，星轮，月轮，日轮，万象，元神，天人，圣人，圣人王，大圣，准帝，大帝。如今，当他成功突破至紫府境后。不光开辟出紫府空间，能够存放外物。体内真元更是尽数蜕变为元力！一旦施展元力，能够直接实现御空飞行！在凡人眼中，此等境界已经与陆地神仙无异！投资族人？姜道玄先是一愣，旋即面露古怪之色。感情系统这是要让自己在乐于助人、雪中送炭的道路上，越走越远啊。不过，这种给羊喂草，再薅羊毛的感觉，似乎还挺不错？这时，一道虚幻面板悄然出现眼前。嗯？家族陷入困境？姜道玄一愣，旋即眼中寒芒乍现。与此同时，姜家大厅。一众姜家族人齐聚在此，气氛紧张而凝重。所有人都知道今日之事非同小可，因此都保持着沉默，只能听到彼此沉重的呼吸声。而在他们面朝门口的位置，正站着一群突然造访的不速之客。这群人皆是身穿灰色劲装，手持寒光森森的长刀，乃是敌对家族唐家的人马。为首者，更是修为已臻至先天九重圆满的唐家族长“唐正阳”。此刻，唐正阳神情淡然，目光随意扫视了一圈大厅布局后，摇了摇头：“这便是你们姜家的议事大厅么？怎么规模如此狭小，居然还不及我唐家茅房大。”“本来我还在想，能够诞生出姜道玄这等人杰的地方该有何等不凡，如今一看，真是大失所望，不如不见。”“不过，同为四大家族，竟然这般贫瘠，说出去简直就是在丢我们所有人的脸面，这样吧，我代表唐家恩赐你们姜家十两银子，助你们重新修缮一番如何？”听到唐正阳的无耻话语，姜家大长老额头青筋一跳。倘若不是你们步步紧逼，我姜家如何会落魄到如今地步？内心愤愤不平，但为了避免引发麻烦，大长老还是强压着内心怒火，沉声道：“这是我们姜家自己的事情，就不劳唐族长费心了。”“自家事？这话就有些不对了，好歹你们姜家也曾附庸过我们唐家寻求庇护，有此情分在里面，怎么就变得生分起来？”“还是说，晋升四大家族的你们已经忘了这一段曾经的渊源，认为你们姜家已经完全脱离了我们唐家的掌控？因此这才将我等视若外人，未曾放在心上？”唐正阳抬起头，目光冷冽，声音中透出几分讥讽之意。眼见对方突然发难，大长老立即明白过来，对方这是专程上门找麻烦来了。他的脸色陡然阴沉下来：“唐族长！我姜家早在数百年就不是你们唐家的附庸了，如今旧事重提，是何用意？难道，仅仅只是为了羞辱我姜家？！”唐正阳双手环抱，面露轻蔑，语气充满嘲弄：“哈哈哈，你便当做羞辱好了。”此话一出，立即引得姜家众人怒目直视。“这就不对了，一群家犬，怎能面向曾经的主人龇牙咧嘴呢？”“不过，我倒是不讨厌看到这种你们明明看不惯我，却还干不掉我的可怜模样。”唐正阳耸了耸肩。以往姜道玄尚在之时，他倒不敢太过放肆，可如今却没有了这些忧虑。面对唐正阳目中无人的嚣张表现，所有姜家人心中的怒意迅速攀升，怒火越烧越旺，气得浑身都发抖起来！一时之间，群情激愤，众人纷纷大声呵斥。大长老也是紧握双拳，怒不可遏。内心愤恨之余，不禁升起些许凄怆。族长，您若是还在，该有多好啊要是自家族长姜道玄还在，区区唐家又岂敢如此放肆！可如今，族长将家族托付给他，前往闭关已有六年，生死不知。而身为家族最强者的自己，也不过只有先天境七重的修为。如何能够抗衡这来势汹汹的唐家？（ps：新书起航，数据太重要了，求读者老爷们别养书！千万别养书！受番茄机制影响，这本书养书的人多了，就会凉掉！）（感谢大家支持！）

Wudan City. The mountain behind the Jiang family. A handsome man wearing a blood-stained white robe with a pale face sat on the futon. Where is this? He looked at the unfamiliar sight in front of him and fell into confusion. Before he could figure out the situation, a massive amount of memories suddenly flooded into his mind. I actually traveled through time? Jiang Daoxuan rubbed his swollen head with his hands. Just by closing and opening his eyes, he traveled through time and became the patriarch of the "Jiang Family", one of the four major families in Wudan City. According to memory, the predecessor stayed in the Xiantian realm for a long time and reached perfection. In order to break through the realm, he resolutely came to the forbidden area of ​​​​the back mountain and began to retreat. However, on the first day of seclusion, someone had tampered with the breakthrough pill, causing the breakthrough to fail and his death unfortunately. And these are still secondary. The most important thing is that because of the failed breakthrough, he has now lost all his realm and has become a useless person with no power! This is a bit bad... Jiang Daoxuan looked solemn. This world is an extraordinary world that combines countless great powers! This is a paradise for the strong. The most powerful can move mountains and fill seas, reach for the stars and the moon, and dominate everything! But it is a hell for the weak. The weak are like grass. If they are not careful, they will be shocked to death by the aftermath of the battle caused by the strong! In such a crazy world, according to his current situation with no cultivation. Your personal safety is not guaranteed at all! And that's not the worst. In my memory, the other three major families have already been eyeing the Jiang family with eager eyes. I don’t know how long I have been in seclusion? What is the situation of the Jiang family today? Jiang Daoxuan frowned, his eyes full of worry. At this moment, a cold voice suddenly sounded in his mind. Jiang Daoxuan was stunned at first, then overjoyed. This is really a mountain with no way to resolve doubts, but there is another village with dark flowers and bright flowers! Without any hesitation, he immediately merged with the innate holy body. The next moment. A layer of pale golden halo began to appear on the surface of Jiang Daoxuan's skin. A strong near-path constitution resonates with the great path. Thousands of strands of Taoist rhyme fell from the void and surrounded him, helping him enter a state of enlightenment! Between the heaven and the earth, waves of Taoist sounds were faintly heard, colorful auspiciousness emerged, and the golden lotus of the earth came into being! The massive power of the avenue washed over the body, making the body like rotten wood glow with majestic vitality again! Her skin was as bright as a divine jade, and her whole body exuded a fragrance like a magical medicine, filling the air. After a while. When Jiang Daoxuan slowly opened his eyes. The body is already filled with surging vitality. He raised his palm and found that it had become crystal clear and flawless. After successfully integrating the innate holy body and Tao embryo and completing the reshaping of the physical body. This physical body becomes more in tune with his soul, realizing the unity of soul and body. Although the appearance has not changed at all, the inside has already undergone a huge transformation! In a sense, this body belongs entirely to oneself, which is equivalent to physical body time travel, rather than soul time travel. But that’s fine too. After all, using someone else's body is inevitably a bit uncomfortable. But fortunately, after completing the physical reconstruction, all these problems no longer exist. Jiang Daoxuan shook his head. Then he raised his spirits, dispersed the Taoist phenomena around him, and used the "Sum of the Whole Clan". In an instant, the surrounding spiritual energy rioted, scrambling to get into his body. A massive amount of spiritual energy flows through all the limbs and bones, flushing the muscles, bones, skin and flesh all over the body. The realm climbed crazily until the innate true essence gathered in the Dantian began to cause qualitative changes through quantitative changes! Wisps of true energy are compressed and transformed into Yuan Power! There was a loud explosion, and a large amount of Yuan Power gathered together, and in an instant, a void opened up in the dantian! Purple air lingers in the void, nourishing the soul and manifesting divine consciousness! The innate realm is perfect! First level of Zifu Realm! Second level of Zifu Realm! The third level of Zifu Realm! Jiang Daoxuan opened his eyes suddenly, his eyes were as bright as lightning and breathtaking! call. A breath of turbid air was exhaled, like an arrow, instantly piercing the ground, leaving a small crater! Is this the scene in the Purple Mansion Realm? If he had been in his previous life, he would have been like a little superman.Bar? Jiang Daoxuan was quite emotional. In this world, the realms are divided into body refining, blood coagulation, bone forging, acquired, innate, purple mansion, Yuanhai, star wheel, moon wheel, sun wheel, all things, soul, heavenly being, saint, saint king, great sage, quasi-emperor, and great emperor. Now, when he successfully breaks through to the Zifu realm. Not only does it open up the Zifu space, it can also store foreign objects. All the true energy in the body has transformed into Yuanli! Once you exert your elemental power, you can directly fly in the air! In the eyes of mortals, this state is no different from that of land gods! Invest in tribesmen? Jiang Daoxuan was stunned for a moment, then showed a strange look on his face. The emotional system is to make yourself go further and further on the road of being helpful and helping others when they need it. However, the feeling of feeding the sheep grass and then gathering the wool seems quite good? At this time, an illusory panel quietly appeared in front of him. Um? Family in trouble? Jiang Daoxuan was stunned for a moment, and then a cold light suddenly appeared in his eyes. At the same time, the Jiang family hall. All the Jiang family members gathered here, and the atmosphere was tense and solemn. Everyone knew that what happened today was no small matter, so they all remained silent and could only hear each other's heavy breathing. And where they were facing the door, stood a group of uninvited guests who had suddenly visited. This group of people were all wearing gray attire and holding long swords with a cold light. They were members of the rival Tang family. The leader is "Tang Zhengyang", the head of the Tang family who has reached the ninth level of innate cultivation. At this moment, Tang Zhengyang looked indifferent, and after casually scanning the layout of the hall, he shook his head: "Is this the meeting hall of your Jiang family? Why is it so small? It's not as big as my Tang family's hut." "Originally, I was still thinking about how extraordinary a place like Jiang Daoxuan would be, but now that I see it, it's really It's a big disappointment. It's better not to see it." "However, if we are one of the four major families, we are so poor. If we tell it, we will lose face. How about, on behalf of the Tang family, I will give you ten taels of silver from the Jiang family to help you repair it." Hearing Tang Zhengyang's shameless words, the eldest elder of the Jiang family felt a vein in his forehead. If you hadn't pressed on every step of the way, how could our Jiang family be in such a state of decline? Inwardly, he was indignant, but in order to avoid causing trouble, the elder still suppressed his inner anger and said in a deep voice: "This is our Jiang family's own business, so we don't have to worry about the Tang clan leader." "Our own family affairs? This is a bit wrong. After all, your Jiang family has also vassalized our Tang family to seek asylum. How can you have such a feeling in it? "So you have become separated?" "Or have you, those of you who have been promoted to the four major families, forgotten this past relationship and think that your Jiang family has completely escaped the control of our Tang family? That's why you treat us like outsiders and don't take it seriously?" Tang Zhengyang raised his head, his eyes were cold, and there was a hint of sarcasm in his voice. Seeing the other party's sudden attack, the Great Elder immediately understood that the other party came specifically to look for trouble. His face suddenly darkened: "Tang Clan Chief! My Jiang family has not been a vassal of your Tang family for hundreds of years. What is the purpose of bringing up the old things now? Is it just to humiliate my Jiang family?!" Tang Zhengyang crossed his arms with contempt on his face, and his tone was full of mockery: "Hahaha, you can just take it as a humiliation." As soon as these words came out, everyone in the Jiang family immediately stared at him angrily. "That's not right. How can a group of domestic dogs bare their teeth in front of their former owners?" "However, I don't hate seeing this pitiful look where you clearly dislike me but still can't kill me." Tang Zhengyang shrugged. In the past, when Jiang Daoxuan was still alive, he did not dare to be too presumptuous, but now he no longer has these worries. Faced with Tang Zhengyang's arrogant and arrogant performance, the anger in the hearts of all the Jiang family members rose rapidly. The anger grew stronger and stronger, and they were so angry that their whole bodies began to tremble! Suddenly, the crowd was furious and everyone shouted loudly. The great elder also clenched his fists, furious. In addition to the resentment in my heart, I couldn't help but feel a little sad. Patriarch, how great would it be if you were still here? If Jiang Daoxuan, the head of our family, was still here, how could the Tang family dare to be so presumptuous! But now, the patriarch has entrusted the family to him and has been in seclusion for six years, without knowing whether he is alive or dead. As the strongest person in the family, he only has the cultivation level of the seventh level of Xiantian Realm. How can we resist the menacing Tang family? (PS: A new book is about to set sail.
